title: Payments/Taxes: Incoming Payments and Payments/Taxes:
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:48 AM
e Which collective invoice account is used by this contract
account together with other contract accounts

e The tax jurisdiction valid for calculation of tax
(U.S./Canada)

e That no invoice is created as a result of specifying a lock
reason for a master data record

General DataContract Account: Remarks                                         Remarks about the contract account in various languages

Payments/Taxes: Incoming Payments and Payments/Taxes:

Outgoing Payments                                                                         e That payments are processed using an alternative payer or

alternative payee
e The payment method that is to apply

e Which bank details are used for incoming and outgoing
payments

e Which card ID is valid for incoming and outgoing payments
e Which mandate applies for incoming payments

e The reason for locking the contract account for incoming or
outgoing payments

Several limited-time locks are possible.

Payments/Taxes: Taxes
e That the withholding tax code is set for incoming and

outgoing payments in the relevant country

That several characteristics are defined for each tax code,
such as the tax rate

e The number and validity period of the certificate issued for
exemption from withholding tax.

e For which country a service was provided

You only have to change the default value here if it differs
from the country key of the business partner's standard
address.

e The tax criteria for sorting companies
e The regional code for automatic address preparation

e The county code for classifying different locations from a
tax point of view

Dunning/Correspondence: Dunning Control
e That the dunning notices are sent to an alternative dunning

recipient but that the actual business partner can also
receive dunning notices

e The grouping category to which the contract account's
overdue items are assigned when executing the dunning
run
